A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MVI-Bench research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the figures, tables, equations, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original evaluations of 18 LVLMs, a four-participant human study, caption-assisted inference experiments, and reasoning analyses in Tables 2–4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original model evaluations, human-study outcomes, and supplementary experiments, including the results in Tables 2–4.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, paired evaluation approach, caption-assisted inference procedure, and attention-based diagnostic procedure are unchanged in Sections 3–4 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 624 image pairs comprising 1,248 VQA instances across six misleading categories, with the same image sources and human-study population.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain identical comparator membership: the 18-model main evaluation, human baseline, caption models, and thinking/non-thinking model comparisons.

E3.justification: The metrics, model configurations, decoding settings, and option shuffling are unchanged. Appendix D.3 retains four human participants answering all 1,248 instances under a five-second limit; removing evaluator names from the acknowledgements does not change this protocol.

E4.justification: The caption assistance, model scaling, and explicit reasoning analyses in Section 4.3 remain identical. Section 4.4's attention-guided masking case study and Appendix E's additional reasoning cases are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Fleiss' kappa of 0.93 on 200 instances in Appendix C.2 and averaging across four human participants in Appendix D.3. No seed, repeated-run, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are retained. For example, Table 2 reports the same misleading-image accuracy of 63.78% for GPT-5 Chat and 98.24% for humans; Table 3 retains 45.99% without captions and 53.85% with GPT-4.1 captions.

T1.justification: The MVI-Sensitivity definition in Equation 1 and relative-attention definition in Appendix D.4 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the taxonomy, paired benchmark, MVI-Sensitivity metric, and LVLM vulnerabilities.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning complementary perception and reasoning, visual forgetting, and spurious correlations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the limitation that the paired analysis does not directly generalize to other datasets without adaptation.

D1.justification: The annotation guidance, prompts, model-source information, human-study instructions, attention implementation, and repository access information remain unchanged. The additional correspondence contact does not revise technical or resource-access instructions.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The Bi et al. CoT-X reference moves from page 10 to page 9 through reflow; it is not a newly added citation.

P1.justification: v4 revises affiliation numbering and Huiyi Chen's listed affiliation, adds Huiyi Chen as a correspondence contact, and removes the sentence thanking two human evaluators. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation/correspondence footnote and shortened acknowledgements cause limited spacing and text reflow on pages 1, 9, and 10. All figures and tables retain their design and placement; the other rendered pages are identical.

improvement.justification: v4 makes administrative edits to author information and acknowledgements, with minor layout reflow. The scientific content, supporting results, reproducibility details, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
